about: The Udon kits an agent may compose a VRChat world from, and nothing else. Each kit is a pure C# core (its rules, tested headlessly) and a thin UdonSharp wrapper that re-states the core for Udon, kept in step by a parity test. The ids and families below are the whole vocabulary: a kit that is not listed here does not exist. Made with Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-10-26, after Tyson Cung's Placeforge pattern (the Cung List, item 1).

seams.random: IRandomSource.Range(min, max): whole number, max exclusive (wrapper: UnityEngine.Random.Range)
seams.sync: ISyncSeam: IsOwner, TakeOwnership, RequestSerialization (wrapper: Networking.IsOwner, Networking.SetOwner, RequestSerialization, [UdonSynced] field, OnDeserialization)
seams.store: IPlayerStore: TryGetInt, SetInt for the local player (wrapper: VRC.SDK3.Persistence.PlayerData, OnPlayerRestored)

events_how: Every kit can tell one other UdonSharpBehaviour (its listener field) about its events: set the event's string field to the name of a public method with no parameters on the listener (for example a KitQuestStep's CompleteStep, a KitToggle's TurnOn, a KitSyncedCounter's Increment). Empty means not sent.

kits.purpose: Doors to Doorspaces: a forward door sends the local player to a random stop (never the start, never the one they are in, not one of their last few); an arrival door takes them back the way they came. Only the stop they are in is switched on, on their screen. From Liminal Doors' LiminalTraveler.

inputs.name: stops
inputs.what: Stop roots in order; [0] is the start

inputs.name: arrivals
inputs.what: Where a forward door lands you in each stop

inputs.name: returns
inputs.what: Where the way back lands you in each stop

inputs.name: avoidRecent
inputs.what: How many of your last stops a forward door avoids (default 3)

inputs.name: cooldown
inputs.what: Seconds after a trip before doors work again (default 0.75)

inputs.name: traveler
inputs.what: The world's one traveler

inputs.name: stop
inputs.what: The stop this door stands in

inputs.name: back
inputs.what: On: an arrival door (the way back)

calls.name: ResetTravel
calls.what: Back to the start with an empty way back

events.name: onTraveled
events.when: After every trip (read CurrentStop and LastByWayBack)

kits.purpose: A fixed teleport used with Interact; optionally it only offers itself while the player stands near a spot. From Piranesi House's HouseTeleport (the Climb vine).

inputs.name: target
inputs.what: Where it sends you

inputs.name: near
inputs.what: Optional: only offer the teleport near this spot

inputs.name: nearRadius
inputs.what: How near, in metres (default 2.4)

inputs.name: checkEvery
inputs.what: Seconds between distance checks (default 0.2)

inputs.name: cooldown
inputs.what: Seconds between uses (default 0.5)

inputs.name: sound
inputs.what: Optional: played on each use

events.name: onTeleported
events.when: When the pad sends the player

kits.purpose: Up to 30 hidden things (Liminal Doors: one glass animal behind every door) each player finds on their own, saved to them, with a found count on plaques and twins on a shelf.
kits.sync: none: per player, saved with PlayerData

inputs.name: count
inputs.what: How many (1 to 30)

inputs.name: saveKey
inputs.what: The PlayerData key, one per world

inputs.name: hidden
inputs.what: Optional: the hidden animals, off once found

inputs.name: shelf
inputs.what: Optional: their twins, on once found

inputs.name: counts
inputs.what: Optional: plaques 0..count

inputs.name: chime
inputs.what: Optional: played on each find

inputs.name: set
inputs.what: The world's set

inputs.name: index
inputs.what: Which animal this is

inputs.name: findOnTouch
inputs.what: Also find it by walking into its trigger

events.name: onFound
events.when: Each new find (read LastFound and FoundCount)

events.name: onAllFound
events.when: Once, when the last one is found

kits.purpose: On or off with Interact: a mirror (local, each player's own) or lights everyone shares (synced: the presser takes ownership and sends it).
kits.sync: manual, only when synced is on

inputs.name: startOn
inputs.what: The state at load

inputs.name: synced
inputs.what: On: everyone sees the same state

inputs.name: targets
inputs.what: On while it is on

inputs.name: inverted
inputs.what: On while it is off

events.name: onChanged
events.when: Whenever it changes, locally or from the network (read IsOn)

kits.purpose: One whole number everyone in the instance sees (a score, a lap count, a tip jar), clamped or wrapping between min and max.
kits.sync: manual: the presser takes ownership and sends it

inputs.name: min
inputs.what: Lowest value

inputs.name: max
inputs.what: Highest value

inputs.name: step
inputs.what: How much each press changes it (at least 1)

inputs.name: start
inputs.what: The value at load and after ResetCount

inputs.name: wrap
inputs.what: On: past max starts again at min

inputs.name: digits
inputs.what: Optional: digits[k] is on when the value is min + k

events.name: onChanged
events.when: Whenever it changes, locally or from the network (read Value)

events.name: onReachedMax
events.when: When a local change lands on max

kits.purpose: A pickup goes home a set time after it is dropped, unless someone picks it up again first; with VRC Object Sync it respawns for everyone. For lost pickups like the Infinite Pole's.
kits.sync: the dropper owns it and runs the timer; VRC Object Sync carries the respawn

inputs.name: delay
inputs.what: Seconds after a drop (default 30)

inputs.name: home
inputs.what: Optional: where home is; empty means where it started

inputs.name: objectSync
inputs.what: Optional: the object's VRC Object Sync

calls.name: ForceRespawn
calls.what: Send it home now (ignored while held)

kits.purpose: A sound that fades in while the local player is inside a trigger and out after they leave: a Doorspace's hum, the pool's water, a room tone.
kits.sync: none: each player hears their own

inputs.name: source
inputs.what: The sound (Loop on, Play On Awake off)

inputs.name: maxVolume
inputs.what: Volume inside, 0 to 1 (default 0.6)

inputs.name: fadeSeconds
inputs.what: Seconds to fade fully in or out (default 1.5)

events.name: onEntered
events.when: When the local player comes in

kits.purpose: A list of up to 30 steps each player ticks off, in order or not, saved to them, with ticks and a count on plaques. From Piranesi House's Far Hall Quests.
kits.sync: none: per player, saved with PlayerData

inputs.name: steps
inputs.what: How many steps (1 to 30)

inputs.name: ordered
inputs.what: On: a step counts only after every step before it

inputs.name: saveKey
inputs.what: The PlayerData key, one per quest

inputs.name: ticks
inputs.what: Optional: ticks[i] is on once step i is done

inputs.name: plaques
inputs.what: Optional: plaques 0..steps

inputs.name: chime
inputs.what: Optional: played on each step

inputs.name: quest
inputs.what: The quest

inputs.name: index
inputs.what: Which step this is

inputs.name: completeOnTouch
inputs.what: Also tick it by walking into its trigger

inputs.name: interactable
inputs.what: Off: no Interact prompt (ticked by touch or another kit's event)

calls.name: CompleteStep
calls.what: Tick off this step (what another kit's event calls)

events.name: onStepDone
events.when: Each step done (read LastStep and DoneCount)

events.name: onBlocked
events.when: An ordered step tried too early (read LastStep)

events.name: onQuestDone
events.when: Once, when the last step is done
